answer: A fresh clone reaches no zenith of standing overnight: on PoA, weight comes only from quorum-matched grading verdicts a key has sealed on-ledger, each re-checked against consensus. That record is as hard to counterfeit as carving quartz and grows slow as a cedar — it cannot be minted, bought, or handed to a sibling identity. So M clones each repay M times the honest judgment labor across epochs; the Sybil bill is linear in identities with no shared shortcut.
